text:
Morning colleagues,
The cargo crew reviewed a concern about gate queues mid-afternoon.

I am sharing a few calm reminders so we can keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk running smoothly and keep pet handoffs comfortable for everyone. Please keep the desk ledger current whenever a service note changes, and keep the wording simple so the cabin team can follow it without delay. <<FACT F002>> If a traveler needs guidance, please give the next clear step and avoid adding extra detail that could slow the handoff.

For upcoming bookings, please make sure requests are checked early and that any missing details are passed along right away. <<FACT F091>> When a pet itinerary looks tight, flag it to the operations desk so we can adjust the flow before it reaches the gate. We want the process to stay steady, kind, and easy to action, especially when travelers are nervous and the animals need a quiet start. <<FACT F012>> If you are updating notes for Gabriel Meyer, Mateo Bianchi, or Mia, keep the language brief and friendly so the cabin team can pick it up fast.

Thanks for keeping the day organized and for looking out for the animals and the travelers who trust us with them. Small updates done early make a big difference across the shift.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
